decisions.rationale: Current blueprint refers to the person uniformly as 'the learner'; 'candidate' survives only inside the compound term 'candidate-local', the captain's own name for the API, immediately glossed in learner terms. Accepted as raised against the pre-commit draft; the raising critic re-verified resolution on the bytes of commit b1d7c9749df4d7784381c19a9c2596fc5018add4.

The build sentence now ends cleanly at '...with its own Vitest test.'; the API constraints moved into a separate sentence whose only parenthetical is 11 words. No content lost. Accepted; resolution re-verified by the raising critic on commit b1d7c9749df4d7784381c19a9c2596fc5018add4.

allowedResources[0] now reads 'the local practice API its README names, started by the learner with the documented npm command', foreclosing the hosted reading; JSON parses. Accepted; re-verified on commit b1d7c9749df4d7784381c19a9c2596fc5018add4.

Blueprint instructions state CORS explicitly and correct the direction (the app reads the API's localhost address from VITE_API_URL); allowedResources is consistent and the JSON remains valid. Accepted; re-verified by the raising SME critic on commit b1d7c9749df4d7784381c19a9c2596fc5018add4.
